name: inl
description: Performs a 32-bit input operation to read a value from the specified I/O port. The _p variant pauses until the I/O operation completes. These functions are used for low-level hardware port access and require proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port number to read from

return_value.success: Returns the unsigned int value read from the port
return_value.failure: May result in a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: These functions are defined as inline macros and require compilation with optimization flags like -O or -O2 to avoid unresolved references; they are hardware-specific and have argument order opposite to some DOS implementations.
